title: Validate Tool-Call Arguments Against a JSON Schema
hints: Recurse with the current JSON pointer. Each keyword only applies to its own kind of value: properties to objects, items to arrays, minimum to numbers, minLength to strings.
In Python, True is an int. Check for bool before you check for integer or number, and compare enum values with the same rule.
Escape keys in the pointer: '~' becomes '~0' first, then '/' becomes '~1'.
Collect every error, then sort by (path, keyword). The model fixes everything in one retry only if you report everything.
